headlines.headline: Under deliberately hidden chemistry, the system has not been shown to hold transferable structure beyond the within-system lookup: M2 vs B3i on V5 is **UNDECIDED** in discovery (selection half, seed 104729, optimistically biased; R19 item 4 NOT_EVALUATED under addendum 1); only the confirmation run can establish it, and that run is NOT_RUN.
headlines.question: Q1
headlines.text: Is there transferable metal-extractant structure in the expanded corpus?

headlines.headline: Under deliberately hidden chemistry, the system has not been shown to reconstruct a missing metal x extractant cell: S1(a)/S1(b) are UNDECIDED, UNDECIDED, UNDECIDED in discovery (learned-arm contrasts are at best UNDECIDED under addendum 1 until confirmation, and the confirmation run is NOT_RUN).
headlines.question: Q2
headlines.text: Can a missing metal x extractant combination be reconstructed?

headlines.headline: Under deliberately hidden chemistry, the system has not been shown to reconstruct Pr/Nd selectivity with the pair hidden: V6 is run once, at confirmation, and the confirmation run is NOT_RUN (not computed (input missing: evaluation/confirmation/decisions/confirmation.json)) -- brief section 34 Q3 is not answered; S2(a)-(c) are NOT_RUN and the selection-half S1(c) counterweight below is discovery only.
headlines.question: Q3
headlines.text: Can Pr/Nd selectivity be reconstructed when direct pair data are hidden?

headlines.headline: Under deliberately hidden chemistry, the system has not been shown to gain from actinide data: H3 is **UNDECIDED (no registered power check)** for the deployed arm M0 -- no WITH vs WITHOUT or WITH vs ACT_PERMUTED contrast passes R19 by its margin and the section 8 injection checks it owes have not run, so it is neither *helps*, *hurts* nor *equivalent*, and it is not a null. F4 (negative actinide transfer) HOLDS under the conservative reading -- under section 10 Gen19 meets a registered failure condition -- and is stated below with both registered readings.
headlines.question: Q4
headlines.text: Does actinide data improve lanthanide prediction?

headlines.headline: Under deliberately hidden chemistry, the system cannot be shown to benefit from any tested architecture component over the descriptor base M0 on strict folds: no ladder step is kept -- M1 and M2 are each removed against M0 on the V5-primary selection half -- the descriptor model M0 beats the factorised M2 on V5: Delta (M0 - M2) = -0.154 log D, BCa 95 % [-0.348, -0.088], p 0.0000, and on V2: -0.154 [-0.259, -0.038]; factorised vs flat (M2 vs FLAT_CAT) Delta 0.103 does not meet delta5 0.106 and its percentile 95 % interval [-0.041, 0.186] includes 0 (FAIL by R19; not a null: UNDECIDED (no registered power check)), and M3, M4, M5, M6, M7 were not run: the rule (neither M1 nor M2 is kept, addendum 3 item 3); M3+ is also not implemented; the discovery ledger demoted M7, M6, M5, M4, M3 by the section 7 item 5 rule at exhaustion of its 60 h budget (`evaluation/discovery/decisions/decisions.json` -> `not_run.M3+`, `budget.discovery`; 'What was not run and why'); the architecture claim is not established, and F6 is checked below.
headlines.question: Q5

headlines.headline: Under deliberately hidden chemistry, the system has not been shown to err sensibly with chemical distance: S1(e) is UNDECIDED_UNRELIABLE (the gate word of `tables/reliability_before_correlation.csv`; the scorer's block records NOT_EVALUATED (`evaluation/discovery/decisions/decisions.json` -> `S1_components.S1e_support_distance`) because the reliability floor is assessed by the power stage, which ran after scoring) -- the deployed predictor's Spearman(cell MAE, support_score) meets the registered threshold and interval rule, but a support-score component (support_s7 per cell) is below the section 8 reliability floor, so the correlation may neither support nor close the claim.
headlines.question: Q6
headlines.text: How does error grow with chemical distance?

headlines.headline: Under deliberately hidden chemistry, the system cannot be called calibrated at every registered level on V5-primary: the deployed predictor M0 misses an S1(d) band (coverage_50) while its 80 / 95 % coverage bands are met and failure condition F3 does not hold; the S1 candidate M2 passes S1(d) in the scorer's block (discovery, selection half).
headlines.question: Q7

headlines.headline: Under deliberately hidden chemistry, the system has not been shown to know when it does not know: the test needs a predictive SD (Spearman(|error|, SD) with the system-cluster interval excluding 0, and coverage in UNSUPPORTED / FAMILY_EXTRAPOLATION within 0.10 of IN_DOMAIN), which only the M7 ensemble provides (not computed (input missing: evaluation/ladder/M7/metrics.json)).
headlines.question: Q8
headlines.text: Can the model identify when it does not know?

headlines.headline: Under deliberately hidden chemistry, the system cannot support a headline process recommendation: every process result is labelled transfer-unsupported (S1, S2 or V6 not established, or an exploratory run; section 14).
headlines.question: Q9
headlines.text: Do Gen18 process recommendations remain good after uncertainty propagation?

headlines.headline: Under deliberately hidden chemistry, the system can classify its Pr/Nd recommendations (one top recipe per specification cell): 9 directly supported, 0 transfer-supported, 0 speculative, 0 unsupported, 0 unclassified; every recommendation carries the label 'transfer-unsupported'.
headlines.question: Q10
headlines.text: Which Pr/Nd process recommendations are directly supported, transfer-supported, speculative or unsupported?

M2 vs B0 and vs B6r0 pass R19 with 0.05 (V5)

coverage bands 50 / 80 / 95 and per category (V5; the scorer's block, arm M2)
the same bands on the deployed predictor's V5-primary coverage rows
Spearman(cell MAE, support_score) <= -0.10, interval excludes 0, components reliable

S1 passed for the deployed predictor on the confirmation half, 5 of 5 withheld seeds

sign in >= 11 of 13 systems; paired direction +0.05
logSF MAE <= FLAT - 0.02 and <= lookup; log D MAE <= L5
top recipe stable in >= 0.80 of re-rankings (only if Phase H runs)
gains only on random split (V0 beats B3, S1(a) fails, V1 interval includes 0)

verdicts.verdict: NOT_EVALUATED -- no contrast of the deployed predictor M0 against B1 or B2 was scored (not computed (input missing: evaluation/discovery/contrasts_exploratory.csv -> key=B5 vs B1|B2@V5|V1|V2))

verdicts.verdict: HOLDS (conservative reading, either registered interval on any registered design; against a WITH deployment: HOLDS; against the registered WITHOUT deployment: does not hold -- both readings in Q4)

verdicts.rule: process optimum depends on unsupported predictions (F5(i) code check; F5(ii) barred vs allowed; only if Phase H runs)
S1(a) fails and no ladder step M1-M6 is kept
verdicts.verdict: UNDECIDED: F6's second clause holds (no step M1-M6 is kept; the retained configuration is M0), but its first clause -- M2 fails S1(a) -- does not: S1(a) is UNDECIDED (R19 item 4 NOT_EVALUATED in discovery; the confirmation run that evaluates it is NOT_RUN), so F6 is not decided and is not a null.
